redteamRejected.why: Carousel's 101 is a real hourly service and it does not come to Beaconsfield. It runs Amersham - Little Chalfont - Chalfont St Giles - Chalfont Common - Chalfont St Peter - Gerrards Cross - Tatling End - Denham - New Denham - Uxbridge, Mon-Fri plus Saturday, along the corridor south-east of the town. All 97 of its stops resolve in NaPTAN to those ten localities and none is Beaconsfield; High Wycombe, also named in the claim, is absent too. Nothing changes on the sheet.
redteamRejected.evidence: Red-team claim of 2026-09-06 (S6-verify/2026-09-06_0719 F012), at high confidence: '101 Amersham - Uxbridge, hourly Mon-Fri via High Wycombe, Beaconsfield (Maxwell Road), Seer Green and the Chalfonts'. Its own named stop falsifies it: Maxwell Road, Beaconsfield is ATCO 040000001225/226 and is served by Carousel 102 (204 calls), 103 (190), 104 (75), 105 (46), 624 (2) and Red Eagle 380 (1) - all of the first four already drawn here - and by no 101. The claim is the Carousel 10x family confused for one another, 101 being the single member that never reaches the town. Note that the ATCO prefix 040000001 is county-wide in Buckinghamshire, so the prefix test our S1 uses cannot answer this and the locality register is what settles it.
